member.name: M:TeachingAssistant.WebAPI.Controllers.ModelHealthController.Get(System.Threading.CancellationToken)
member.summary: Sends a tiny test prompt to the configured model and reports whether it answered.
member.remarks:
Its job is to verify the whole path to the model before any real grading runs: API key configured, model ID valid, network reachable, structured response parsed. It costs one very small request, so call it on demand, not as a frequent probe (use GET /health for that).
Not implemented yet: the controller will delegate to an Application-layer service (backed by the Anthropic client in Infrastructure) and currently returns 501.
member.param: Aborts the model call if the client disconnects.
member.returns: A with the model ID, latency and the model's reply.
member.response: The model answered the test prompt.
